paragraphs.text: Syr Armont is a Human woman and Knight from Ardenvale , Eldraine .
Armont is renowned throughout the realm for her kindness, beauty, and devotion to Ardenvale. She cannot ignore injustice.

Armont was an Ardenvale knight captain. Looking for a way to heal the Realm after the New Phyrexian Invasion , she journeyed deep into the Wilds with her band of loyal knights . In the forest she stumbled upon Redtooth Keep, where the ancient bloodline of elves lived. The elves were cursed to transform into werefoxes at night.

Armont committed herself to solving this mystery and breaking the curse. Some of her knights, concerned with their own survival, battled against the werefoxes despite Armont's wishes. Yenna , leader of the werefoxes, warmed up to Armont's kindness and told her of an enchanted rose guarded by an archon in a glade nearby that would break the spell. Armont and Yenna ventured to the glade in search of the rose, and the knight was able to break the curse. It is implied the two fell in love.
Armont is based on Beauty of Beauty and the Beast .
